grid_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE 3x3 NPC character design sheet for the indie fantasy RPG 未名之海.
Primary request: Nine creatively designed NPCs in one single numbered nine-square board. Consistent with the ORIGINAL male traveler image provided, NOT nine different rendering styles. A coherent cast of memorable residents, diverse ages, faces and body silhouettes. First five are existing GDD characters; last four are OPTIONAL design candidates, not new mandatory game systems.
Input image1: the approved original traveler. Use it ONLY as the EXACT visual STYLE reference: polished softly shaded anime-inspired 3D character render, appealing dimensional faces, natural cloth and leather, readable slightly simplified forms, warm ivory/sage/charcoal/brown, modest brass accents. NPCs must look like they could stand beside this hero in the same game, but do not clone his face, youthful age, body type or jacket.
Output: one large square high-resolution board, exactly 3 columns x 3 rows, nine equal cells, warm pale gray studio background, subtle fine grid rules. One whole character in each cell from top of hair/headwear to bottom of shoes, no clipping. Each stands in a natural relaxed front or gentle three-quarter pose, occupying almost full cell height with space beneath for a small legible Chinese label. Hands and distinctive tools readable, no extreme action or seated poses. Each NPC may hold or wear ONE simple signature object. The small construct in cell9 may occupy less cell height to communicate its smaller size. No scene backgrounds, no multiple views within a cell, no UI, no title, no logos, no watermark. No overlap between cells. Labels in reading order 01 through 09, exactly as below.
World: a cozy, quietly mysterious waterside settlement built among old gardens and repair workshops. Friendly lived-in fantasy residents who cook, trade, repair, care for people and tend plants. Their creative visual identity comes from practical objects reimagined into simple costume shapes, patchwork and material combinations. No sailor, naval, pirate costume, no anchors, no ship captain, no ancient royalty, no towering ornate weapons, no space suits, no obvious existing franchise characters. Keep clothing buildable in a small 3D game, no thousands of beads or hair strands, no gigantic trailing gowns or capes. This is an exploratory concept sheet, not final character models.
Nine cast designs, keep all distinct:
01 TOP LEFT, exact label “01 阿汀｜汤棚”: existing female soup-shelter caretaker, about 40, broad friendly smile, soft round cheeks, dark hair swept into a low bun with a wooden spoon pin. Stocky welcoming adult silhouette, cream rolled-sleeve blouse, moss-sage patched apron shaped in large overlapping leaf panels, cocoa trousers and comfortable short boots. One sturdy brass ladle in one hand. An amber lantern-shaped small fabric pocket and visibly repaired apron make her memorable without elaborate ornament.
02 TOP CENTER, exact label “02 陶满｜杂货”: existing male oddments merchant, about 35-45, wiry body, narrow mischievous eyes, dark wavy hair, small trimmed mustache and playful knowing grin. Faded terracotta waistcoat over oatmeal shirt, roomy dark cropped trousers, practical boots. One compact wooden drawer-case strapped at hip with just FOUR broad labeled-looking blank drawer fronts, a chunky ceramic fragment held in hand. Small old brass windchime on case but only two thick tubes, no mass of dangling clutter. A charming collector of ordinary old things, no giant merchant backpack.
03 TOP RIGHT, exact label “03 岑弦｜修械”: existing FEMALE weapons/tool mechanic, late twenties to thirties, angular focused face, dark teal short asymmetrical hair with one neatly clipped side, calm serious expression. Slate short fitted work jacket with a very clear cream rolled cuff, warm tan reinforced trousers, work boots, a simple brass ear-protection plate on one ear. One large simple caliper carried closed at her side, contrasting gloved and ungloved hands. Clean precise silhouette, restrained amber seam accents. Practical craftsperson, not futuristic gun soldier.
04 MIDDLE LEFT, exact label “04 苏苇｜护理”: existing FEMALE caregiver, around 45-55, thoughtful face with subtle smile lines, warm brown skin, long dark braid gathered over one shoulder with pale streaks, oval small spectacles. Dusty lavender-gray tunic, ivory short apron, dark straight trousers, soft brown boots. Holding a little weathered name notebook against her chest, one thick flask hanging close to belt. Broad reed-leaf-shaped cloth collar and one embroidered stitched line of small leaves, no medical cross logos or modern nurse uniform. Compassionate human warmth, not mystical healer priest.
05 MIDDLE CENTER, exact label “05 陆铆｜炼化”: existing MALE refining craftsman, around 60, slightly stooped but strong, square weathered face, cropped silver hair, bushy silver eyebrows and short beard. Broad sturdy hands in rough fingerless work gloves. Soot-blue shirt, short dark leather apron with a single prominent mismatched round patch, brown trousers and heavy worn boots. Distinctive flip-up goggles with TWO DIFFERENT COLORED lenses, one amber and one smoky teal. Holding a compact rounded old mechanism in palm, not a giant hammer or machine. Craft workshop identity, not a wizard.
06 MIDDLE RIGHT, exact label “06 叶眠｜菌圃·候选”: optional young ADULT female mushroom-and-herb gardener, early twenties, serene face, dark warm-red bob, visible ordinary human ears. One beautiful broad but modest mushroom-cap-shaped straw sunhat, woven rather than a giant real mushroom, pale sage and ochre short layered gardening smock, close-fitting cream sleeves, dark knee-length culottes and sturdy ankle boots. Carrying ONE small round shallow wicker basket with three chunky gently luminous blue mushrooms. Leaf-shaped large cloth patches, no bare feet, no giant magical staff. A distinctive cozy botanical silhouette.
07 BOTTOM LEFT, exact label “07 石禾｜钓客·候选”: optional elderly MALE bank angler, about 70, tall thin slight forward lean, deeply expressive smiling wrinkles, thick white eyebrows, sparse silver hair and short pointed beard. Patched muted indigo waistcoat with broad ochre cloth lining, ivory high-collar shirt, charcoal loose trousers and simple boots. A short folded wooden angling stool clipped close to belt and ONE large stylized ceramic fishing float held in hand, no long rod crossing cell borders. Cheerfully stubborn rather than solemn sage, quirky eyebrows and asymmetrical coat hem give identity. No fisherman's nautical uniform.
08 BOTTOM CENTER, exact label “08 纸雀｜绘图·候选”: optional MALE young adult local sketcher, about 22, gentle inquisitive narrow face, tawny side-swept hair, medium tan skin, large round glasses. Warm sand short jacket with slate-blue sleeves, moss trousers, practical lace-up boots. A single folded fan-shaped drawing board under arm, one stubby charcoal pencil tucked behind ear, small light paper-bird-shaped hair clip folded from stiff cloth, no actual bird companion. Sketches plants and garden paths, not a navigator or explorer of the world's secret. Slight ink stains and broad simple pockets, clever graphic readable silhouette.
09 BOTTOM RIGHT, exact label “09 芽罐｜园丁·候选”: optional SMALL NON-HUMAN old garden helper automaton, knee-to-waist high compared with adult residents, charming rounded humanoid posture. Body made from ONE weathered ivory ceramic plant pot, tiny sage moss tuft and two broad leaves growing from the rim, two short sturdy wooden articulated arms with mitten-like brass grippers and two thick little wooden/brass feet. A single warm amber circular glass eye in a brass inset on the front, a small simple shutter like an eyelid. A miniature hand trowel held close to body. A repaired brass band around cracked pottery gives personality. Soft dimensional materials and endearing expression match the same 3D universe, no complex gears or thin legs, not a modern robot or floating creature.
Quality: refined cohesive soft 3D renders like reference1; recognizable different adult faces, believable anatomy, pleasant confident character design, legible full-body silhouettes, strong age/body variety. Main cast feels useful and approachable; creative details remain simple enough to translate into 3D. At least nine clearly separate subjects, precisely one per cell. All five established NPC names/roles and four candidate labels correctly spelled.
